failure_detail: [DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION] deterministic validation: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType Required change: Correct this deterministic error while preserving all unrelated candidate semantics.

[LOGIC] gen:IMO_069_Shape / sh:or third branch / devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower property shape: The conditional branch has no sh:minCount, so the property shape is satisfied when devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower is absent; consequently, an antecedent value of true does not require the independent-power value to be present and true. Required change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower property shape in the true-antecedent branch, while retaining sh:hasValue true and sh:datatype xsd:boolean. | [LOGIC] gen:IMO_069_Shape / sh:or second branch / addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower property shape: This branch requires at least one false value but does not prohibit a simultaneous true value. A multi-valued antecedent containing both false and true can therefore satisfy this false branch without satisfying the required independent-power condition. Required change: Constrain the false-antecedent branch to exclude true values, for example by adding sh:not [ sh:hasValue true ] to that property shape, or remove the redundant branch and retain an equivalent false-or-absent branch.

[LOGIC] I2-051-ShipShape/sh:sparql: The SPARQL constraint rejects every positive-shear case whose position lies between 0.6 LUI and 0.9 LUI unless Cf is exactly 0 or 1, although the requirement specifies Cf only for the aft-through-0.6 LUI interval and the 0.9-LUI-through-forward interval and imposes no Cf value in the intervening interval. Required change: Do not produce a violation solely because a positive-shear position is in the unspecified 0.6-to-0.9 LUI interval; enforce the Cf boundary values only within their explicitly specified intervals, while retaining FI = Cf × FIB for positive-shear cases. | [CONTROLLED_VOCABULARY] I2-051-ShipShape/nltl:hasCalculationCase/[nltl:shearForceDirection]: The direction value is constrained only by cardinality, so an arbitrary resource or literal can be supplied; the SPARQL formula is then skipped unless the value happens to equal nltl:positiveShearForce, allowing an invalid direction value to bypass the positive-shear applicability condition. Required change: Constrain nltl:shearForceDirection values to the canonical shearForceDirectionValue class, while retaining the conditional formula enforcement only for nltl:positiveShearForce.

[LOGIC] gen:TRF_042_PlatingShape/sh:sparql[1] and nltl:hullStructuralSteelGrade/sh:in: The candidate does not support the requirement's provision for steels with different yield stresses whose actual accepted yield-stress values may be substituted: every listed normal-strength grade is forced to exactly 235 MPa, every listed high-strength grade is forced to at least 315 MPa, and sh:in prevents identifying any other steel grade. Required change: Allow an identified accepted steel with a different substituted yield stress, while retaining 235 MPa for normal-strength steel and at least 315 MPa for high-strength steel; do not exclude the canonical representation needed for accepted substituted grades.

[DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION] deterministic validation: COMPLEX_READINESS required input(s) absent from candidate: averageIcePressure, lineLoad, loadPatchHeight, loadPatchLength, localIcePressure, shapeCoefficient: COMPLEX_READINESS required input(s) absent from candidate: averageIcePressure, lineLoad, loadPatchHeight, loadPatchLength, localIcePressure, shapeCoefficient Required change: Correct this deterministic error while preserving all unrelated candidate semantics.

[UNIT_CONVERSION] gen:TRF070Shape applicable branch / nested sh:sparql: The mandatory direct check compares the raw capacity and pressure numeric values only when their unit IRIs are identical. The canonical capacity is in kN and local ice pressure is in MPa, so the query performs no comparison for the required operands and can allow an insufficient capacity to conform. Required change: Implement the direct check using dimensionally compatible, properly converted operands or an explicitly represented externally assessed result; do not rely on identical unit IRIs or compare raw kN and MPa values. | [OWNERSHIP_PATH] gen:TRF070Shape / nltl:hasDesignCondition nested sh:sparql: The comparison query binds ?ship to any resource linked to the focus design condition rather than to the ship currently being validated. A shared design condition can therefore obtain localIcePressure from another ship and affect this ship's conformance. Required change: Evaluate the comparison in the targeted ship context or otherwise constrain the query to the current ship's nltl:hasDesignCondition path and its nltl:localIcePressure value.

[LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or second branch/sh:sparql: The SPARQL branch is inverted for SHACL conformance: it selects non-applicable cases as violations, and also selects applicable category A/B ships constructed on or after 2017-01-01. Consequently, the outer sh:or rejects non-applicable cases with missing applicability data and rejects applicable cases even when the loading-condition requirements are satisfied. Required change: Make the SPARQL constraint select only cases that establish applicability, so the branch conforms when the category/date combination is outside category A or B on or after the threshold, while preserving xsd:date validation for every present constructionDate value. | [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or first branch/loadingConditionCase/sh:node/sh:or: The residual-stability-factor alternative is allowed regardless of alternativeInstrumentApplicable. A loading condition with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true and residualStabilityFactorSI=1 can therefore pass without alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true, although the declared formula requires the permitted alternative-instrument outcome when the alternative applies. Required change: Guard the residualStabilityFactorSI=1 branch with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=false, leaving the alternative branch as alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true together with alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true.
